newsitem.title: SPAIN: Prosegur reaffirms strategy under new head.
newsitem.headline: Prosegur reaffirms strategy under new head.

text.p: The board of Spanish security firm Prosegur met on Tuesday to reaffirm its strategy after chairman Herberto Gut died in car accident earlier this month, a statement from the firm said.
"Prosegur confirms its management policy and the development of its strategic plans", the firm said.
The board confirmed Enrique Moya Frances as its new chairman and named Helena Revoredo de Gut deputy chairwoman. Christian and Chantal Gut Revoredo were named board members.
The group's executive committee will be coordinated by the chairman and will incorporate Helena Revoredo de Gut.
The Prosegur group employs 25,000 and had turnover of around 67.0 billion pesetas in 1996, expected to rise to 82.0 billion pesetas in 1997.
The firm forecasts that future international expansion, particularly in Latin America, will in future account for half of turnover.
